name: manage_recipe
description: Manage recipe creation and updates. For create/update actions, both ingredients and instructions are required. For get action, only recipe_name is needed.

action.description: Action to perform on the recipe. Use 'create' for new recipes, 'update' for existing ones, and 'get' to retrieve recipe details.

recipe_name.description: Name of the recipe to create, update, or retrieve

changes.description: Recipe details or changes to make (required for create and update actions only)

ingredients.description: List of ingredients required for the recipe

instructions.description: List of preparation steps in order
